cc:Work.dc:title: Box - AngledBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Box with both ends cornered
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes AngledBox --x 180 --y 100 --h 70 --n 1 --top 'angled hole' --bottom_edge e --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes AngledBox --x --h --n --top --bottom_edge --reference
